items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: I'd go and blow my horn and they, after I played in the race, that was Bud Johnson and his brother, Cag.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, and what about the Blue Moon Synccapades? Blue Moon Chasers.

Yeah, Chasers. Chasers. That's Bud Johnson and his brother. That was in Dallas. Yeah. A young band. And I used to go up there and they wanted me to come and blow my horn. I'd go and blow my horn and they, after I played in the race, that was Bud Johnson and his brother, Cag. Cag Johnson. And then there was a banjo. One of the guys got killed in the train wreck. One of the banjo. I can't remember all the names right fast. Oh, don't worry.
You know, Clyde Carr was out there in Texas.
